properties.name: dcc.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Dynamic Config Center auto-configuration.

properties.name: dcc.connect-string
properties.description: ZooKeeper connection string, for example 127.0.0.1:2181 or host1:2181,host2:2181.

properties.name: dcc.root-path
properties.description: Root path used by Dynamic Config Center to read configuration nodes from ZooKeeper.
